title: Depth under pushing forward by an embedding
statement: Let $e$ be an embedding of the coordinates of a finite cube of dimension $m$ into one of dimension $n$. Let $S$ and $T$ be sets of available coordinates in the two cubes such that $e(i)\in T$ for every $i\in S$. For any binary decision tree on $S$, pushing it forward along $e$ preserves its depth.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding from the coordinates of the $m$-dimensional cube to those of the $n$-dimensional cube
